provenance.featurePolicy: Union of observed exact numeric SGB tip IDs. Exclude grouped SGB rows and corresponding numeric IDs in both cohorts; exclude non-SGB leaves and unmapped tips. Renormalize each retained profile to one. No pseudocounts, rarefaction, or shared-observation intersection.
provenance.metric: Normalized weighted UniFrac: sum of branch length times absolute difference of descendant shares / sum of branch length times sum of descendant shares. Reference root retained, root stem excluded.
provenance.ordination: Classical PCoA; Lingoes correction sqrt(d^2+2c) off diagonal, c=-minimum eigenvalue when negative. Percentages use corrected positive inertia. Raw distances remain available and used in summaries.
provenance.limitations: Same reference database, not verified identical processing. Sid weight units and preprocessing remain unverified. UFPF cross-sectional, five Sid profiles from one treated person. IBD bowel preparation confound. No inference, health score, or disease classification. Reference coverage denominators differ by source.
provenance.diagnosisConflict: UF-PF-2022-074-1N: Diagnosis Control vs Diagnosis2 PD; labeled Uncertain diagnosis and excluded from diagnosis-specific views.
